mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profile_summary) AS profiledUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_segment WHERE segment_code = 'HIGH_VALUE') AS highValueUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_segment WHERE segment_code = 'AT_RISK') AS atRiskUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_payment_amount), 0) FROM user_profile_summary) AS totalPaymentAmount, (SELECT MAX(data_version) FROM user_profile_summary) AS dataVersion, (SELECT MAX(calculated_at) FROM user_profile_summary) AS calculatedAt
SELECT segment_code AS segmentCode, segment_name AS segmentName, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM user_segment GROUP BY segment_code, segment_name ORDER BY userCount DESC

SELECT t.tag_code AS tagCode, /* 品类名直接取 product_category（已数据治理：id=7 与 22 统一为'服装鞋靴'，无同义分裂） */ CASE WHEN t.tag_code = 'FAVORITE_CATEGORY' AND pc.category_name IS NOT NULL THEN pc.category_name ELSE ut.tag_value END AS tagValue, /* 下钻用原始值（tag_value 已统一，直接回原值） */ ut.tag_value AS filterTagValue, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) / totals.total_count AS userRatio, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(ps.total_payment_amount), 0), 2) AS avgAmount FROM user_profile_tag ut JOIN profile_tag_definition t ON t.id = ut.tag_id JOIN (SELECT tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_count FROM user_profile_tag GROUP BY tag_id) totals ON totals.tag_id = ut.tag_id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON t.tag_code = 'FAVORITE_CATEGORY' AND pc.id = CAST(ut.tag_value AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary ps ON ps.user_id = ut.user_id WHERE (#{tagCode} IS NULL OR t.tag_code = #{tagCode}) GROUP BY t.tag_code, tagValue, filterTagValue, totals.total_count ORDER BY t.tag_code, userCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(p.user_id) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(p.total_order_count), 0) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(p.total_payment_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.segment_code = 'AT_RISK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS atRiskUsers FROM user_profile_summary p LEFT JOIN user_segment s ON s.user_id = p.user_id

SELECT province, amount, userCount FROM ( SELECT t.province AS province, t.amount AS amount, t.userCount AS userCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.amount DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT u.province AS province, COALESCE(SUM(p.total_payment_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(p.user_id) AS userCount FROM user_profile_summary p JOIN ecommerce_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.province IS NOT NULL AND u.province != '' GROUP BY u.province ) t ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT '其他省份', SUM(amount), SUM(userCount) FROM ( SELECT t.province AS province, t.amount AS amount, t.userCount AS userCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.amount DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT u.province AS province, COALESCE(SUM(p.total_payment_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(p.user_id) AS userCount FROM user_profile_summary p JOIN ecommerce_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.province IS NOT NULL AND u.province != '' GROUP BY u.province ) t ) r WHERE r.rn > 5

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, u.gender, u.age, u.province, u.city, COALESCE(p.total_order_count, 0) AS totalOrderCount, COALESCE(p.total_payment_amount, 0) AS totalPaymentAmount, COALESCE(p.average_order_amount, 0) AS averageOrderAmount, COALESCE(p.browse_count_30d, 0) AS browseCount30d, COALESCE(p.login_count_30d, 0) AS loginCount30d, p.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, s.segment_code AS segmentCode, s.segment_name AS segmentName, s.segment_score AS segmentScore FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_segment s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT td.tag_code AS tagCode, td.tag_name AS tagName, CASE WHEN td.tag_code = 'FAVORITE_CATEGORY' AND pc.category_name IS NOT NULL THEN pc.category_name ELSE ut.tag_value END AS tagValue FROM user_profile_tag ut JOIN profile_tag_definition td ON td.id = ut.tag_id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON td.tag_code = 'FAVORITE_CATEGORY' AND pc.id = CAST(ut.tag_value AS UNSIGNED) WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY td.id

SELECT u.gender AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY u.gender

SELECT CASE WHEN u.age BETWEEN 0 AND 17 THEN '0-17' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '18-24' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 25 AND 30 THEN '25-30' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN u.age BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '41-50' ELSE '50+' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(u.age)
SELECT COALESCE(sg.segment_name, '未分层') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_segment sg ON sg.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IN #{id} GROUP BY sg.segment_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT '平均客单价' AS label, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ps.total_payment_amount), 2), 0) AS avgPayment, COALESCE(SUM(ps.total_payment_amount), 0) AS totalPayment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary ps ON ps.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IN #{id}

SELECT ut.tag_value AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.user_id) AS cnt FROM user_profile_tag ut JOIN profile_tag_definition td ON td.id = ut.tag_id AND td.tag_code = 'CONSUMPTION_LEVEL' WHERE ut.user_id IN #{id} GROUP BY ut.tag_value ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT id, category_name AS categoryName FROM product_category

SELECT a.tag_value AS activeLevel, c.tag_value AS consumeLevel, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS userCount FROM user_profile_tag a JOIN user_profile_tag c ON c.user_id = a.user_id JOIN profile_tag_definition ta ON ta.id = a.tag_id AND ta.tag_code = 'ACTIVE_LEVEL' JOIN profile_tag_definition tc ON tc.id = c.tag_id AND tc.tag_code = 'CONSUMPTION_LEVEL' GROUP BY a.tag_value, c.tag_value ORDER BY a.tag_value, c.tag_value
